name: Natalia
source: Natalia is the neighbour of Allison. She is a beautiful Italian woman, married to Larry who is abusive to her. She also suspects that Larry is cheating on her. The constant abuse from Larry, including him repeatedly calling her "an ugly cow", has given her very low self-esteem.
